description: Ministry of Justice - Order made to declare that the Provisions, of Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters Act. No. 25 of 2002 shall apply in respect of the Agreement between Sri Lanka and Ukraine Governments
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the declaration of the application of the Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters Act to a specific international agreement. It is a legal instrument (an Order) made under an existing Act, dealing with mutual legal assistance in criminal matters between two countries. This fits the definition of a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5), which includes statutory instruments, regulatory frameworks, and legal notices.
